name: Marlon Hoffstadt
description:
Marlon Hoffstadt moves up the poll one year after making his debut at No.100. And with good reason. In 2026, the German star made his Coachella debut, bringing 200 ravers with him on stage. He also played Ultra Miami’s main stage, and spun back-to-back with trance final boss Armin van Buuren, all before making his Tomorrowland main stage debut.

His ‘Das Ist Daddy’ album was another defining moment, assembled in just eight weeks from his ever-growing catalogue. Meanwhile, his Free Rave charity fundraising party at Amnesia, meanwhile, kept him grounded. Still, if he could remix the year, he’d likely opt to slow it down a little to take it all in. “You spend so much time preparing for this one moment and then suddenly it happens,” he says.
styles: “Fast, high energy, hands in the air, good vibes.”
